token_hint: HubSpot registers no client on the spot: create an MCP auth app in your HubSpot account with this console's redirect URL, and enter its client ID and secret when you connect.

name: Airtable
description: Read and write bases, tables and records.
token_hint: A personal access token scoped to the bases the agent should see.

name: Zapier
description: Run Zaps and reach the apps behind them.

name: Make
description: Run scenarios and manage a Make account. You supply the MCP URL Make gives your account.

name: n8n
description: Access and run workflows. Self-hosted: you supply the URL.

name: ClickUp
description: Tasks, docs and goals across spaces.

name: Trello
description: Boards, lists and cards.

name: Todoist
description: Search, complete and manage tasks.

name: Calendly
description: Event types, availability and bookings.

name: Zoom
description: Search, recap and act on meetings. You supply the URL Zoom gives your account.

name: Miro
description: Read and create content on boards.

name: Lucid
description: Diagram, ideate and align teams.

name: Excalidraw
description: Create hand-drawn style diagrams.

name: Box
description: Search, edit and get insights on Box content.

name: Dropbox
description: Search, organize and act on Dropbox content.

name: Shopify
description: Build, manage and analyze a store. Each store has a server of its own; you supply its URL.

name: Mailchimp
description: Create and analyze marketing campaigns.

name: Resend
description: Send transactional and marketing email.
token_hint: An API key. Sending is a side effect - scope it to one domain.

name: PostHog
description: Query and manage product analytics.

name: Mixpanel
description: Analyze and query events.

name: Snowflake
description: Retrieve structured and unstructured data. You supply your account's server URL.
token_hint: Point it at a read-only role - this server can run SQL.

name: Databricks
description: Unity Catalog and Mosaic AI, over managed servers. You supply your workspace's server URL.

name: Google BigQuery
description: Query and analyze BigQuery datasets with read-only and write-capable SQL tools. Official Google remote MCP server.
token_hint: Enable the APIs and MCP service described in the setup guide. Open More options and register your own Google web OAuth client with the displayed redirect URL, then enter its client ID and secret. Cloud services require MCP Tool User plus the product-specific IAM permissions; availability depends on your account and region.

name: PagerDuty
description: Incidents, services and on-call schedules.

name: Postman
description: API collections and specs, as context for a coding agent.

name: Vercel
description: Analyze, debug and manage projects and deployments.

name: Netlify
description: Create, deploy and manage sites.

name: Railway
description: Deploy, manage and debug apps and infrastructure.

name: Replit
description: Turn ideas into apps and websites.

name: Hugging Face
description: The Hub, and thousands of Gradio apps.

name: GitBook
description: Create, edit and manage documentation.

name: Figma
description: Generate diagrams and code from Figma context.

name: Webflow
description: Manage CMS, pages, assets and sites.

name: Wix
description: Manage and build sites and apps.

name: WordPress.com
description: Manage WordPress.com sites.

name: Semrush
description: SEO, competitor research and traffic analysis.

name: Meta Ads
description: Read and manage Facebook and Instagram ad accounts, campaigns and their results.

name: Google Ads
description: Report on campaigns with Google's own Ads server, which you run. It only reads.
token_hint: Google publishes this server to run yourself, for example on Cloud Run with streamable HTTP. Paste its URL and the bearer it checks; it signs in to Google Ads with your developer token and OAuth credentials.

name: Google Analytics 4
description: Query GA4 reports and properties with Google's own Analytics server, which you run. It only reads.
token_hint: Google publishes this server to run yourself, for example on Cloud Run with streamable HTTP. Paste its URL and the bearer it checks; it reads GA4 with a service account or your Google credentials.

name: Similarweb
description: Web, app and market data.

name: Typeform
description: Create forms and analyze responses.

name: SurveyMonkey
description: Design surveys, collect responses, analyze results.

name: DeepL
description: Translate text and documents.

name: ElevenLabs
description: Create and manage voice agents.

name: Xero
description: Read financials from any conversation.

name: Canva
description: Find, generate and export designs from a team's Canva workspace.

name: monday.com
description: Read and update boards, items and updates on a monday.com account.

name: Neon
description: Query and manage serverless Postgres branches, roles and databases.

name: Datadog
description: Search metrics, logs, traces and monitors while an incident is open.
token_hint: An application key paired with an API key, scoped to the metrics and logs the agent should read.

name: Sanity
description: Read and edit structured content in a Sanity dataset, schema included.
token_hint: A robot token for the project, with read or write access to the dataset the agent should see.

name: Buildkite
description: Read pipelines, builds and job logs, and find out why one went red.

name: Amplitude
description: Ask product analytics questions about events, funnels and cohorts.
token_hint: An Amplitude API key and secret for the project whose data the agent may read.

name: Fireflies
description: Search meeting transcripts, summaries and action items.
token_hint: An API key from Fireflies settings. It reads every meeting the account can see, so use one belonging to a member whose calendar the agent should have.

name: Egnyte
description: Search and read documents in an Egnyte tenant's shared folders.

name: Apify
description: Run scrapers and automation actors, and read what they collected.
token_hint: An Apify API token. Actor runs are billed to the account that owns it, so give the agent one with a spending limit.

name: Firecrawl
description: Crawl and read a website as clean text, one page or a whole site.
token_hint: A Firecrawl API key. Crawls draw on the account's page credits.

name: Semgrep
description: Scan code for security and correctness findings, and explain a rule.
token_hint: A Semgrep app token, scoped to the projects whose findings the agent should read.

name: DeepWiki
description: Ask questions about any public GitHub repository's code and docs.

name: Supermemory
description: A memory the agent writes to and searches across conversations.
token_hint: A Supermemory API key. Everything the agent stores is readable by anything else holding it.

name: Tally
description: Read forms and their responses, and see what people submitted.
token_hint: A Tally API key. Responses often hold personal data, so scope it to the forms the agent needs.

name: Pipedream
description: One endpoint onto thousands of app APIs, authenticated per account.

name: Composio
description: A managed gateway onto hundreds of SaaS tools, with auth it holds for you.
token_hint: Composio issues a server URL per user or per toolkit; paste that URL and its key. Which tools appear is decided in Composio.

name: Activepieces
description: Run automation flows and the app integrations behind them.
token_hint: The token from the MCP server page of the Activepieces project whose flows the agent may run.

name: Smithery
description: A registry gateway: reach servers hosted on Smithery through one endpoint.
token_hint: A Smithery API key. It decides which hosted servers the agent can reach, so it is worth reviewing what the account has installed.

name: Pydantic Logfire
description: Query traces, spans and metrics from a Logfire project with SQL.
token_hint: A read token for the project. The host is regional - swap `logfire-us` for `logfire-eu` if the project lives there, or the token will not be recognised.

name: LangSmith
description: Read traces, runs and datasets from a LangSmith workspace.
token_hint: A LangSmith API key, scoped to the workspace whose traces the agent should read.

name: Honeycomb
description: Ask a question of production telemetry while an incident is open.
token_hint: A Honeycomb management or configuration key for the environment the agent may query.

name: Exa
description: Search the web semantically and read the pages it finds.
token_hint: An Exa API key. Searches draw on the account's credits.

name: Tavily
description: Search, extract and crawl the web for an agent that needs current facts.
token_hint: A Tavily API key. Each search spends a credit on the account that owns it.

name: Bright Data
description: Collect public web data through a managed scraping network.
token_hint: A Bright Data API token. Collection is billed by request, so give the agent one with a zone limit.

name: Qdrant
description: Store and search vectors in a Qdrant collection.

name: Clerk
description: Read users, sessions and organizations from a Clerk instance.

name: WorkOS
description: Manage SSO connections, directories and organizations.

name: Render
description: Read services, deploys and logs, and find out why one failed.
token_hint: A Render API key for the workspace whose services the agent may read.

name: Contentful
description: Read and edit entries, assets and content types in a space.
token_hint: A Content Management API token, scoped to the space and environment the agent should reach.

name: Storyblok
description: Read and edit stories and components in a Storyblok space.
token_hint: A personal access token for the space. A management token can publish, so use a read-only one unless the agent should.

name: Attio
description: Read and update records, lists and notes in an Attio CRM.

name: Pipedrive
description: Read and update deals, contacts and activities in a pipeline.

name: Klaviyo
description: Read campaigns, flows, lists and metrics for email and SMS.

name: Cal.com
description: Read availability and book, move or cancel meetings.
token_hint: A Cal.com API key for the account whose calendar the agent may book against.

name: Vapi
description: Create and inspect voice agents, calls and their transcripts.
token_hint: A Vapi private API key. Placing calls costs money per minute, so use a key on an account with a cap.

name: CircleCI
description: Read pipelines, workflows and job output, and find out why a build failed.

name: New Relic
description: Query APM data, logs and alerts with NRQL while something is on fire.
token_hint: A New Relic user API key for the account whose telemetry the agent may read.

name: Statsig
description: Read feature gates, experiments and their results.
token_hint: A Statsig console API key. A console key can change gate rollouts, so use a read-only one unless the agent should.

name: Lusha
description: Look up business contact and company data for a prospect.

name: Custom server
description: Any MCP server reachable by URL. Its tools are introspected on connect.
token_hint: Optional. Leave blank for a server that needs no authentication.
